2 days Golden Triangle tour

Delhi · Agra · Jaipur · 2 days

2 days Golden Triangle tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

The tightest version of the route: Agra on day one, Jaipur on day two, back in Delhi by night. Long days, but all three cities in a weekend.

At a glance

Duration
2 days, 1 night
Destinations
Delhi · Agra · Jaipur
Transport
Private AC car
Accommodation
1 night in Jaipur
Tour type
Private
Pickup
Hotel or airport in Delhi NCR
Return
Day 2, late evening

What makes this one worth it

  • Taj Mahal and Agra Fort on day one
  • One hotel night in Jaipur with breakfast
  • Amber Fort, with an elephant ride to the gate if available
  • City Palace, Jantar Mantar and Hawa Mahal on day two

Your day by day

  1. Day 1 · 7:00 AM

    Delhi to Agra

    Pickup from your hotel, the airport or any address in Delhi NCR, and about three hours to Agra in a private AC car.

  2. Day 1 · 10:00 AM

    Taj Mahal and Agra Fort

    Meet your guide in Agra for the Taj Mahal, then Agra Fort, the red sandstone fortress of the Mughals.

  3. Day 1 · Afternoon

    On to Jaipur

    About four hours west to Jaipur. Check in. Overnight in Jaipur.

  4. Day 2 · 9:00 AM

    Amber Fort and Jal Mahal

    Breakfast and checkout. Amber Fort — with an elephant ride up to the gate if one is available — then a photo stop at Jal Mahal, the water palace.

  5. Day 2 · Midday

    City Palace, Jantar Mantar and Hawa Mahal

    The City Palace, the Jantar Mantar observatory and the Hawa Mahal.

  6. Day 2 · Afternoon

    Back to Delhi

    The drive back to Delhi, arriving in the evening at your hotel or chosen address.

What the price covers

  • Private AC car and chauffeur for both days
  • Licensed guides in Agra and Jaipur
  • One night hotel with breakfast
  • Monument tickets
  • Tolls, parking and taxes

What it does not cover

  • Lunch and dinner
  • Elephant ride at Amber
  • Camera fees
  • Tips

Questions people ask

Is two days too rushed?
It is the shortest the route works at. You see everything, but spend about ten hours in the car across the two days. Three days is noticeably easier.
Can we start from the airport?
Yes, and many people do this between flights.
Is it private?
Yes — your own vehicle and driver, with local guides in Agra and Jaipur.
